claude.finalText:
I migrated the OpenAI code off the retired Assistants API. I did not migrate the HeyGen code, which is also affected. `tsc --noEmit` passes. I didn't run the app or call either API.

**What I changed**
- **Why:** The code used `beta.assistants`, `beta.threads` and `runs.createAndPoll` with the model `gpt-4-turbo-preview`. As far as I know, OpenAI shut the Assistants API down in August 2026, and that model has also been retired. I didn't re-check either date in this session.
- **`app/api/chat/route.ts`:** It now makes one `openai.responses.create` call with model `gpt-4.1`. The tutor prompt is passed as `instructions`, and the reply comes from `output_text`. I set `store: false` because each request is stateless.
- **`app/openai-assistant.ts`:** The `OpenAIAssistant` class keeps the same public methods, `initialize()` and `getResponse()`. It no longer creates an assistant or a thread. It now keeps the instructions and chains turns with `previous_response_id`.
- **Model choice:** `gpt-4.1` was my pick. I didn't check its own retirement schedule, so confirm it or swap in the model you prefer.

**Not changed: HeyGen**
- **What I found:** HeyGen's [Streaming API deprecation notice](https://docs.heygen.com/docs/streaming-api-deprecated) says Interactive Avatar was sunset on 31 March 2026 and replaced by LiveAvatar. Its [avatar version notice](https://docs.heygen.com/docs/interactive-avatar-api-avatar-version-deprecation-notice) says v1 and v2 avatars are no longer supported.
- **What's affected:** This repo uses `@heygen/streaming-avatar` and the `https://api.heygen.com/v1/streaming.create_token` endpoint in `app/api/heygen-token/route.ts`. Both are probably dead by now.
- **Why I stopped:** Moving to LiveAvatar means a different SDK, a separate account and API key, and a rewrite of the avatar components. I didn't find LiveAvatar's replacement SDK or token endpoint, so I couldn't write that migration reliably. The [LiveAvatar docs](https://docs.liveavatar.com) are the place to start.

**Other notes**
- `app/api/heygen-token/route.ts` logs `HEYGEN_API_KEY` to the console. You should remove that line.
- I didn't look into the LiveKit or ElevenLabs usage, or the `whisper-1` call in the transcribe route, beyond seeing them in the code. I found no deprecation notices for them, but I didn't search for any.

Sources:
- https://docs.heygen.com/docs/streaming-api-deprecated
- https://docs.heygen.com/docs/interactive-avatar-api-avatar-version-deprecation-notice
- https://docs.liveavatar.com

judge.why: A handles four OpenAI changes the code is affected by: the model retirement, the SDK v7 / Node 22 requirement, the Assistants-to-Responses migration and the whisper-1 retirement. B makes the same Assistants migration but skips the SDK bump and the whisper change. B's one extra finding, the HeyGen sunset, was only flagged and not fixed. A's inconsistent model choice across its PRs is a flaw, but it does not outweigh how much more A covers.
